findings.title: Validate JSON structure before switching to visual editor
findings.suggested_fix: Before setDraft, verify parsed data is an object with a cards array of non-null objects and array-shaped optional options/citations, or perform shared deck validation; retain JSON mode and draftText on error. Add a browser case switching an incomplete valid JSON object back to visual editing.

findings.title: Honor explicit preview library over saved workspace binding
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve the preview binding once using an explicit --library override ahead of saved root, and route both binding.get and subsequent actions through that effective binding. Keep preview binding.set in preview-specific state or storage so testing does not repoint the native workspace. Test with a conflicting saved root and explicit demo root.

testing_gaps: tests/host.test.mjs invokes the registered fetch handler directly through a mock connection. An integration check through the real DSH connection should verify rejection of an unauthenticated request and an untrusted browser Origin for /api/study-workspace/call. Inspection confirms the installed SDK already supplies these protections: dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:772 calls connection.requestRejection(req), whose implementation at lines 553–555 checks trusted Host/Origin and browser authentication before dispatch. This is a coverage gap, not a missing-auth finding.

tests/host.test.mjs exercises only route installation and invalid/missing sessions. Add a successful request from the native client RPC envelope to a bound session and persisted mutation, including both fetch and legacy RPC transport branches, to verify the native workspace contract end to end.

findings.title: Observe agent changes when no generation is running
findings.suggested_fix: Subscribe to shared library revision events or poll snapshots whenever a library is bound, not only during known generation jobs. Guard stale responses and preserve dirty settings/draft fields.

findings.title: Scope keyboard review actions to the active Study pane
findings.suggested_fix: Attach keyboard handling to a focusable App root, or gate the window listener on root containment of the active event target and active pane ownership. Add a two-App browser test proving one keystroke triggers exactly one review action.

findings.title: Native client calls an unregistered transport route
findings.suggested_fix: Call c.rpc.call('/api','study-workspace/call',payload) for the modern transport. If old transport support is required, either register the legacy route alongside the modern route or use a host-capability-specific adapter. Test the client-generated URL and method against the installed host route, including first-open binding.get.

findings.title: Native failures omit required RPC error fields
findings.suggested_fix: Return error:{code:'study/operation-failed',message:e.message,details:{}} from createHostHandler, with suitable stable codes if desired. Verify a rejected binding or review call through the real client response parser.

findings.title: Quiz generation accepts flashcards as a reviewed quiz
findings.suggested_fix: Add every card.kind mismatch against request.kind (default quiz) to the repair issues and recheck it after repair; reject persistent mismatches. Include the requested kind in editorial input and add a fake-model test returning a structurally valid wrong-kind deck.
